thread_title: S. naczii 'wild lid' Okaloosa Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. naczii 'wild lid' Okaloosa Co, FL

posts.body_html:
I just made up that name BTW, the plant doesn't actually have a tag with that name on it. Just noticed this naczii with a really crazy lid, kinda reminds me of S. 'Bengal Tiger': sarracenia.proboards.com/thread/2448/catesbaei-bengal-tiger but more of a jungle version of it....not the well thought out, perfectly shaped and veined version that you'd see in the city: you know, the well groomed suit and tie look, clean cut and well cared for, but rather the look you'd see when you go into the rainforest of Brazil and see some natives that haven't ever seen modern man, you know what I'm sayin?

Pics taken 6/10/19. If I hadn't ever seen carnivorous plants before, I'd think this clone looks kinda scary. S. 'Scary?!" hehe


Pretty normal from the back view. Check out those other flava-esque Nacziis in the background:




Doesn't this thing look like one of those frilled dragons ready to bite you?

It does just fine when the traps are full of water, they're not tall enough to fall over.

I divided this clone last winter, so it's no longer at vegetative maturity and looking super wild like in the pics above, but check out those veins and colors! Pics taken 10/1/21:
